_note: Fixed facts of the rig and protocol that no results script emits. Each value names its source; the paper's macros read them here (spec task 8.6). Not results.

probe.source: datasheet figures, as in amodo-power-experiments spec §3 (never measured)

model.source: amodo-power-experiments spec (one LM); dimensions are the LMSpec defaults in amodo code/workloads/model.py, a synthetic decoder-only transformer built in torch

sample_rate_source: amodo capture configuration; also the T5 chain note (spec §12, 2026-10-06)
r1_positive_control_source: spec §3 check 6: R1's design candidates had to flag >= 99% of pure-training windows from a session R1 never saw
default_decision_source: stage two's majority vote: code/detectors.py TwoStageForest.predict calls a window training iff stage one calls it AI and stage-two P(training) > 0.5, i.e. s_C > 0.5

colocation_share.source: commanded training share of the three concurrent runs; at 0.5 neither loop is paced (amodo spec/phases/05-workload-panel.md, amendment 2026-09-23)

gk.source: Gargiulo & Kulp, arXiv 2609.00309, and the dataset README at revision bcd3f8dd
gk.alias_source: spec §12 2026-10-09 and results/gk/t5.md: features above ~10 kHz differ (anti-alias FIR on G&K only)
gk.trace_source: Gargiulo & Kulp, arXiv 2609.00309: 930 genuine five-second traces, each one workload

harness_line_source: the ~200 ms harness modulation (notes/2026-10-01-5hz-line.md); line5hz_stage_a.json rule harness_hz
rt_window_source: Rahman & Tajdari, arXiv 2606.19262 appendix A.3: 5, 15, 30 and 60 s sliding-window snapshots of NVML telemetry

chain_check.source: amodo-power-experiments spec/spec.md at e17159d, tasks 3.4 (band fraction, envelope at 200 kS/s against a 2 MS/s reference) and 3.5 (capture budget)

digitiser.source: amodo-power-experiments spec/spec.md §5 (instrument) and code/acquisition/ at 9679c88: streamed raw at the retained rate, no driver averaging and no anti-alias filter before the ADC

aliasing.source: amodo-power-experiments results/channel/out-of-band/out-of-band.json at 9679c88 (spec task 3.2): verdict.total_folded_fraction = 0.00324 (training) and verdict.idle_folded_fraction = 13.17, power above the 100 kHz retained Nyquist over in-band power, from 100 MS/s bursts, assuming zero rejection. The 20 kHz band fraction (chain_check) is from the same bursts (band-decomposition.json)

intervals.source: code/declaration.py BLOCK_WINDOWS, N_BOOT (circular block bootstrap of 5 s-hop windows; coverage.py and heldout.py reuse them); code/monitor.py EPISODE_BLOCK, N_BOOT_INTERVAL, ONSET_BLOCK = 600 windows of the 1 s hop. Thresholds are held fixed in every resample; code/monitor.py N_BOOT_BOUND and code/ceiling.py N_BOOT (10,000) for the episode lower bounds and the TOST interval

forest_trees_source: code/detectors.py FOREST_KWARGS and code/declaration.py IFOREST_KWARGS: n_estimators = 500, random_state = 0, scikit-learn defaults otherwise
